_comment: Checked-in snapshot of the Supabase `cohorts` table, used to bake real class dates into
the static HTML (scripts/build-static-content.mjs) and to generate the subscribable
calendar (scripts/build-ics.mjs). Supabase remains the live source of truth — the browser
still fetches it and overrides anything here. This snapshot exists so that Googlebot and
no-JS visitors get real dates instead of an empty banner.
SCHEDULE TEXT: every row below carries the approved neutral wording. PDA no longer offers
night or evening classes (Amanda, 2026-07-06), so no generated page may ever print an
evening time. Three rows in the live Supabase table (May 25, Jun 2, Jun 22 2026) still
hold dead evening strings from before the July 6 neutralization; they are deliberately NOT
mirrored here. See docs/toolbox-build-report.md — Amanda needs to clear them in Supabase.
Refresh with: npm run sync:cohorts (prints the SQL to re-pull), then npm run build:static.
